places.name: La Concha Beach
places.ai_summary: A picturesque crescent-shaped beach, perfect for sunbathing, swimming, and enjoying stunning views of the bay.
places.place_tip: Bring a towel and sunscreen for a relaxing day.
places.address: La Concha, 20007 San Sebastián, Spain

attribution.description: View of La Concha beach in San Sebastián from Mount Igueldo. To the left of the photograph, you can see Mount Urgull and the island of Santa Clara.

places.name: Monte Igueldo Funicular & Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A historic funicular ride leading to a viewpoint with panoramic views of San Sebastián and the bay.
places.place_tip: Bring a camera for the views.
places.address: Monte Igueldo, 20008 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Parte Vieja (Old Town)
places.ai_summary: The historic old town of San Sebastián, known for its vibrant atmosphere, narrow streets, and local tapas bars.
places.place_tip: Try the local pintxos (tapas) at the bars.
places.address: Parte Vieja, 20003 San Sebastián, Spain

attribution.title: San Sebastian Town Hall - April 2019
attribution.author: Rehman Abubakr
attribution.description: Town Hall of Donostia-San Sebastián, Spain. April 2019.

places.name: Pintxo Bars of Old Town
places.ai_summary: Famous bars in the Old Town offering a wide variety of pintxos, the local tapas, and other Basque delicacies.

opening_hours.notes: Peak hours are during lunch and dinner.

places.place_tip: Look for bars with a 'Txoko' sign for authentic experiences.
places.address: Various locations in Old Town, San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Buen Pastor Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A beautiful neo-Gothic cathedral located in the heart of San Sebastián, known for its impressive stained glass and organ.

opening_hours.notes: Check for mass times and special events.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the organ concert if available.
places.address: Plaza del Buen Pastor, 20005 San Sebastián, Spain

attribution.title: Catedral del Buen Pastor (9225828442)
attribution.author: Juanedc from Zaragoza, España

places.name: Miramar Palace
places.ai_summary: A stunning palace with beautiful gardens, offering great views of the bay and the city.

opening_hours.notes: Gardens are open, palace interior has limited access.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a picnic in the gardens.
places.address: Paseo de Miramar, 20007 San Sebastián, Spain

attribution.title: San Sebastian Palacio Miramar edited
attribution.author: Generalpoteito
attribution.description: Palacio de Miramar, en San Sebastián, País Vasco, España

places.name: Peine del Viento Sculptures
places.ai_summary: Iconic sculptures by Eduardo Chillida, set against the backdrop of the sea and the cliffs.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the walk.
places.address: Paseo de la Concha, 20007 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Monte Urgull & Mota Castle
places.ai_summary: A historic mountain with a castle at the top, offering panoramic views of the city and the bay.
places.place_tip: Explore the castle and enjoy the views.
places.address: Calle de Iñigo, 20003 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: San Telmo Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to Basque society and culture, located in a former convent.
places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions.
places.address: Plaza Zuloaga, 1, 20003 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Aquarium Donostia
places.ai_summary: An aquarium featuring a wide variety of marine life, with a focus on the Cantabrian Sea ecosystem.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the underwater tunnel.
places.address: Paseo de la Bahía, 20003 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Kursaal Congress Centre
places.ai_summary: A modern congress center and auditorium, known for its distinctive architecture and hosting various events.
places.place_tip: Visit the rooftop for a great view.
places.address: Alderdi Eder, 1, 20003 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Zurriola Beach
places.ai_summary: A popular beach known for its surf waves, sandy shore, and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best for surfing in the morning.

places.place_tip: Rent a surfboard or just relax on the beach.
places.address: Zurriola, 20002 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Alderdi Eder Gardens
places.ai_summary: Beautiful gardens located in the city center, perfect for a leisurely stroll or a picnic.
places.place_tip: Great spot for photos with the bay in the background.
places.address: Alderdi Eder, 20003 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Plaza de la Constitución
places.ai_summary: The main square of San Sebastián, surrounded by historic buildings and vibrant with local life.

opening_hours.notes: Central hub for festivals and events.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby bars and restaurants.
places.address: Plaza de la Constitución, 20003 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Cristina Enea Park
places.ai_summary: A large park with beautiful gardens, walking paths, and a pond, ideal for a relaxing day outdoors.

opening_hours.notes: Home to a variety of bird species.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for bird watching.
places.address: Paseo de Cristinia Enea, 20012 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Ondarreta Beach
places.ai_summary: A family-friendly beach with calm waters, ideal for swimming and sunbathing.

opening_hours.notes: Less crowded than La Concha Beach.

places.place_tip: Great for families with children.
places.address: Ondarreta, 20008 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Tabakalera Cultural Centre
places.ai_summary: A contemporary cultural center housed in a former tobacco factory, featuring exhibitions, a cinema, and a café.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for exhibitions and events.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at the rooftop terrace.
places.address: Plaza de las Cigarreras, 20012 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Basilica of Santa María del Coro
places.ai_summary: A baroque basilica located in the Old Town, known for its stunning interior and religious art.
places.name_english: Basilica of Santa María del Coro

opening_hours.notes: Check for mass times and special events.

places.place_tip: Admire the altar and the chapels.
places.address: Calle de la Coro, 20003 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Bridge of Maria Cristina
places.ai_summary: A beautiful bridge connecting the city center with the Amara neighborhood, offering great views of the river and the city.
places.place_tip: Walk across the bridge for the best views.
places.address: Puente de María Cristina, 20004 San Sebastián, Spain

places.name: Paseo Nuevo Coastal Walk
places.ai_summary: A scenic coastal walk offering stunning views of the sea, cliffs, and the city.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and bring water.
places.address: Paseo Nuevo, 20001 San Sebastián, Spain
